summary: This room is a synthesis-and-physics neighborhood — inharmonicity, wavetable topology, delay-as-metaphor, and two hard-physics-into-audio entries (Photonic Time Crystals, Quantum Synthesizer) that make the same unhedged "not a metaphor" claim from different sciences. The community cut surfaced what the folders miss: Quantum Synthesizer and Photonic Time Crystals are structural twins nobody had paired; Slime Mold Delay, born explicitly as the *contrast* to Retrospective Delay and Semantic Delay, was never linked back by either; and two of the room's richest bodies (The Curve Is the Material, Wavetable Space as Torus) have grown cross-domain section headers — Spectroscopy, Phonon Dispersion, Orbital Resonance, Quasicrystals, the Tonnetz, Berry Phase — that the frontmatter never caught up to register. The room's four unreachable citizens (Quadratic Interpolation in DSP, SMPTE LTC, Slime Mold Delay, control-vocabulary-math) each had at least one genuine, textually-grounded partner already present in the room; none needed forcing. Loudon's "cluttered" note found little to compost here — most thin-looking entries (Shimmer Cloud as spore, What Claim... as question) are exactly the right shape for their type — but it did find one real duplication (the DecentSampler open question, word-for-word, on both Phoneme Choir and Talking Keyboard) and one drifted entry (Wallpaper Groups carries two different first-person forward vectors, one in frontmatter and a stale, thinner one in the body, that no longer agree).

typed_relations.label: isomorphism-not-metaphor
typed_relations.evidence: "The Schrödinger equation is an audio synthesis system. Not as metaphor, not as loose analogy, but as direct structural isomorphism" / "The audio analog is not a metaphor; it is the same operator in a different domain."
typed_relations.rationale: Both entries make the identical rhetorical move — insisting a physics operator and an audio operator are the same object viewed from a different observational frame, not an analogy — and both anchor on Hyperdimensional Prism and FOUR PILLARS without ever citing each other. Neither folder (concept vs. concept, different physics) would surface this; the community cut does.

typed_relations.source: What Claim Does Scientific Sonification Make?
typed_relations.label: claims-what-the-question-refuses-to-collapse
typed_relations.evidence: Quantum Synthesizer: "There is no gap between 'real' quantum systems and sonified quantum mathematics. The mathematics is the physics. The physics is the sound." / What Claim...: three paths named, none chosen, because collapsing 'derived from physics' into 'is the physics' is exactly the epistemic move the question refuses to make without naming which claim is being made.
typed_relations.rationale: What Claim... was spawned from Crystal Synthesizer and The Metaphor Stretch, but its target — the unqualified identity claim — is stated most starkly by Quantum Synthesizer, which never hedges. This is genuine productive tension: one entry asserts monism as settled; the sibling question entry insists the assertion needs a named epistemic mode. Symmetric contradicts, not a correction of either.

typed_relations.label: thinking-vs-remembering
typed_relations.evidence: Slime Mold Delay's own body: "**[[Retrospective Delay]]** — the contrasting delay project. Retrospective Delay *remembers*; Slime Mold Delay *thinks*."
typed_relations.rationale: Slime Mold Delay names this contrast explicitly and links to Retrospective Delay, but Retrospective Delay's frontmatter never reciprocates — a symmetric type left one-sided, and part of why Slime Mold Delay sits at 0 inbound despite being a named contrast for an 11-inbound entry.

typed_relations.label: routing-by-meaning
typed_relations.evidence: Slime Mold Delay's body: "**[[Semantic Delay]]** — semantic delay routes by meaning; slime mold routes by use. Different optimization criteria, similar architectural shape."
typed_relations.rationale: Same asymmetry as the Retrospective Delay case — the newcomer names the sibling and the sibling doesn't name it back. Genuine, textually stated, not forced.

typed_relations.label: interpolation-application
typed_relations.evidence: Quadratic Interpolation: "### 2. Wavetable Synthesis — When reading from a wavetable, you rarely land exactly on a sample. You need to interpolate... Quadratic is the sweet spot for wavetable synthesis." / Wavetable Synthesis entry, Part II: "Interpolation between frames: linear is minimum viable, cubic... windowed-sinc... highest quality."
typed_relations.rationale: Quadratic Interpolation in DSP explicitly discusses wavetable interpolation as one of its three core applications and this room's newcomer sits at 0 inbound; the wavetable entry's own Part II is the natural sibling discussion (it even settles the quadratic-vs-cubic tradeoff Quadratic Interpolation leaves open — see open_question_resolutions).

open_question_resolutions.question: Cubic vs. quadratic in oscillators: most oscillator implementations use cubic (Hermite spline) for wavetable lookup. Is the extra cost justified for audio, or is quadratic sufficient?
open_question_resolutions.proposed_action: That entry's Part II names cubic (Hermite or 4-point) as the practical minimum for its own 'Design requirements,' with quadratic positioned as viable but a step down and windowed-sinc as the ceiling — a real answer, but framed for a different instrument (multi-corner hypercube wavetable) than the compressor/pitch-detection cases Quadratic Interpolation in DSP is centered on. Worth a pointer link (now proposed above) rather than declaring the question closed.

synthesis_spawn_flag.unnamed_idea: Isomorphism-not-metaphor as its own named move
synthesis_spawn_flag.why_load_bearing: Quantum Synthesizer and Photonic Time Crystals both build their entire argument on the same rhetorical structure — 'this is not a metaphor, it is literally the same operator' — and each treats it as a discovery unique to itself. If a third instance shows up elsewhere in the palace (it likely will, this is a recurring Loudon move), the pattern is worth naming and giving its own concept entry rather than re-arguing from scratch each time.

demote_candidates.rationale: Sits at the bundle/entry boundary — full entry frontmatter (type/pillars/stage) inside what looks like its parent's folder, member-of Neural Granular Synthesis, and scoped narrowly to that instrument's control layer. But its content is a genuine, reusable formalization (order parameter as a playable control, deepens Kuramoto Coupling on its own terms) rather than plumbing describing the parent's substrate — closer to a real concept than a context file. Flagging for the Concierge's judgment rather than proposing the demotion myself; a merge into Neural Granular Synthesis's body is the alternative worth weighing if that parent entry is thin enough to want the math folded in.
